text.description_html:
Deltana ZA2012, ZA Modern Value Soap Holder With Glass

The contemporary appeal of the Modern Value Series Soap Holder can be found both in the contemporary wall mount with its sleek concealed screw design and in the 2 chic finishes in which it is available. The brackets are made of zinc and aluminum (available in satin nickel or polished chrome finishes) and the dish is made of glass. The modern square mount brings interesting design to the lowly soap dish. It is made with the attention to quality Deltana is known for and when mounted to the wall, this soap dish will make an ultra fashionable--yet functional--accessory to any bathroom.

Shop more of the Deltana ZA Series Bathroom Accessories

Features and Specifications of the Modern Value Glass Soap Dish:

  • Material: zinc and aluminum wall mount (available in satin nickel or polished chrome finishes) with a glass dish
  • Soap Dish Diameter: 4-1/4"
  • Soap Dish Length At Base: 2-5/8"
  • Soap Dish Height: 1-1/4"
  • Overall Height: 2-1/4"
  • Overall Projection: 5-5/8"
  • Wall Mount Length: 1-1/8" square
  • Concealed screw mounting for a clean, contemporary look.
  • Deltana ZA2012 ZA Soap Holder with Glass Specifications (PDF)

Sold Individually. Package includes: 1 soap dish, mounting screw cover, and all necessary mounting screws.

This is a Limited Series. Limited Quantities Available
